cards.title: Read the schema
items: PK is a primary key, FK a foreign key and UK a unique constraint. A question mark after a type means that the column allows null.
All 465 columns in 23 tables are included. Use Lens, search or zoom to inspect their fields.
53 cross-table foreign keys are drawn. The additional self-reference plan_drafts.parent_id → plan_drafts.id is recorded in the fields.

cards.title: Permissions and enrollment
items: An organization role does not grant a training plan. The same Run + Strength offer can enroll multiple independent athletes.
A product enrollment freezes a plan snapshot; workouts hold planned sessions and completion history.

cards.title: Feedback privacy
items: Voice receipt rows contain a private transcript and an expiry time; raw recordings are not retained.
AI conversations and health rows remain private. This diagram contains schema metadata only, never account values or credentials.
